## Answer
The 5 genres with the most tracks are Rock (1,297 tracks), Latin (579 tracks), Metal (374 tracks), Alternative & Punk (332 tracks), and Jazz (130 tracks).

## Data
| Genre | TrackCount |
|---|---|
| Rock | 1297 |
| Latin | 579 |
| Metal | 374 |
| Alternative & Punk | 332 |
| Jazz | 130 |

## SQL used
```sql
SELECT g.Name AS Genre, COUNT(t.TrackId) AS TrackCount
FROM Genre g
JOIN Track t ON g.GenreId = t.GenreId
GROUP BY g.GenreId, g.Name
ORDER BY TrackCount DESC
LIMIT 5;
```

## Notes
- Results are ordered by track count in descending order, limited to the top 5 genres.

*(Note: Emulation with 4x CPU throttling and Fast 4G network conditions was applied for a mid-range phone simulation).*

## Core Web Vitals
| Metric | Value | Rating |
|---|---|---|
| LCP | 1756 ms | Good |
| CLS | 0.05 | Good |
| INP | not measured | n/a |
| FCP | not measured | n/a |
| TTFB | 269 ms | Good |

## Diagnosis
The page load performance is dominated by the Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) time of **1,756 ms**. A breakdown of the LCP time reveals that the vast majority of the delay stems from element render delay rather than network or loading issues:
- **Time to first byte (TTFB)**: **269 ms** (15.3% of total LCP time)
- **Resource load delay**: **26 ms** (1.5% of total LCP time)
- **Resource load duration**: **8 ms** (0.5% of total LCP time)
